newsitem.title: USA: US Plains cattle feedlots quiet, no trade-feedlots.
newsitem.headline: US Plains cattle feedlots quiet, no trade-feedlots.

text.p: U.S. Plains feedlot cattle markets were quiet, with packers said to have the cattle they need to get through most of next week, feedlot sources said.
"I think we're done for the week," a Kansas feedyard manager said.
Packer bids were light at $62.00 per cwt and passed by owners asking mostly $63.00, with a few at $64.00, they said.
Light sales were possible Thursday at $63.00, steady with this week's trade, for remaining cattle that would grade select and choice, some sources said.
